defs: def row($coll; $key; $id): .config[$coll][] | select(.[$key] == $id); def source_of($trigger): row("event_sources"; "event_source_id"; (row("triggers"; "trigger_id"; $trigger) | .source.event_source_id)); def workspace($binding; $collection; $prompt): . as $d | row("callback_bindings"; "binding_id"; $binding) as $b | $d | row("event_sources"; "event_source_id"; $b.event_source_id) | .source_collection == $collection and ($d.assets[$prompt] | (contains("make worktree BRANCH=") | not) and (contains("Do not run `git commit`") or contains("Do not run git commit")));

jq.name: the implement workspace callback is bound and the worker may not commit
the scenario no longer requires the ceiling to be a gents checkout
the recon tools read the ledger from the grok root, which the environment may override
the live task runs the probe scripts from the configured scripts directory
jq.expr: .config.tasks[] | select(.task_id == "port-live-task") | .prompt_template | (contains("packs/grok_tui_port/scripts") | not) and contains("grok_edge_probe.py --edge offline") and contains("grok_stock_pty_probe.py self-test") and contains("grok_stock_pty_probe.py cleanup")

jq.name: final review prompt watches the job key to a terminal state
jq.expr: .assets["tasks/port_final_review_task/prompt.md"] | contains("gents job watch") and contains("--until-terminal") and contains("wait_process") and contains("session_id:tool_call_id")

jq.name: watch command takes the whole job key, not an angle-bracket placeholder
jq.expr: .assets["tasks/port_final_review_task/prompt.md"] | contains("gents job watch KEY ") and contains("gents job watch trigger-session:abc123:call456 ") and contains("gents job show KEY") and (contains("gents job watch <key>") | not) and (contains("gents job show <key>") | not)

jq.name: the final-review Task has goal_objective_template and its Tools enable goal tools
the job block meets C5.11
jq.expr: .config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == "port-final-review-tools") | .integrations.plugins[] | select(.plugin == "gents/review_changes") | .job | (.agent_targets | length) == 4 and (.dynamic_targets == null) and .policy.dynamic == "off" and .policy.trusted_packs == ["gents/code_review"] and .max_spawns == 128 and .max_wall_secs == 7200

jq.name: agents.target_ids equals job.agent_targets with enabled false
